request.style: English, gospel, joyful powerful female lead vocal, full gospel choir with call and response, tambourines, hand claps, Hammond B3 organ, piano, bass, drums, celebratory, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Down by the Nile where the tall reeds grow
A baby cried in a basket boat
His sister stood at a distance
To see what would happen to him
Then his sister said to Pharaoh's daughter
Shall I go and find you a Hebrew woman to nurse the child for you

[Verse]
Years of brick and straw and the whip upon the back
Then Moses stretched out his hand and the sea rolled back
The Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground
And the LORD brought the waters of the sea back over them

[Pre-Chorus]
Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron's sister
Took a tambourine in her hand
And all the women followed her
With tambourines and dancing

[Chorus]
Sing to the LORD, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he hurled into the sea
Sing to the LORD, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he hurled into the sea

[Bridge]
The LORD is my strength and my song
He has become my salvation
He is my God, and I will praise him
The God of my father, and I will exalt him

[Chorus]
Sing to the LORD, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he hurled into the sea
Sing to the LORD, for he is highly exalted
Horse and rider he hurled into the sea

[Outro]
Sing to the LORD
Horse and rider he hurled into the sea
